message:
The other day, I was packing a go-bag for our family, and my granddaughter, Mia, decided she wanted to help. As I pulled out some extra clothes and snacks, she insisted on adding her favorite stuffed bear. I chuckled and said, "Sweetheart, I think we need to pack practical things first." 

But as I watched her carefully tuck that bear inside, it struck me how important those little comforts can be in a stressful time. Sometimes, it’s not just about what we think we need, but also about what brings us comfort and peace. 

In the end, we had a great conversation about plans and what to do in case of an emergency, all while Mia held on to her bear like a lifeline. It reminded me that preparedness doesn’t just mean practicality; it also means being mindful of what soothes our hearts. 

What little things do you think can bring comfort in tough times?
